tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search live KeepBal tools and models locally, free of charge. Use 2–200 query characters. Results are ranked and paginated; use category models for models.

tools.name: inspect_tool
tools.description: Read local public tool metadata, known parameters, pricing metadata and a JSON request example. Fixed tools show the per-call price; variable tools are billed at provider price + 35%. This is not an input-specific quote. Free; does not contact a provider. Unknown input schemas are explicitly marked.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Execute a public tool with your prepaid KeepBal wallet using the REST billing and access controls. Inspect first. Fixed tools charge the per-call price; variable tools are billed at provider price + 35%. Use input.max_cost_usd for a catalog spending cap; it must cover estimated cost and requires suf

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Check and settle an existing run by run_id through REST ownership and access controls. No new execution or additional polling fee; the original execution charge may settle. Use after run_tool reports pending.
